definitions.gloss: errand, business, matter to attend to
definitions.explanation: Something that needs to be done or dealt with.

examples.japanese: {用事|ようじ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{失礼|しつれい}します→失礼：01247_shitsurei⟧。
examples.english: I have some business to attend to, so excuse me.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{用事|ようじ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: I have a lot of errands today.

examples.japanese: {用事|ようじ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{終|お}わったら→終わる：00567_owaru⟧⟦{連絡|れんらく}する→連絡：01524_renraku⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{待|ま}っていて→待つ：00469_matsu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: I'll contact you when I'm done with my errands, so please wait.

notes:
{用事|ようじ} refers to things one needs to do, from errands to appointments.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {用事|ようじ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: to have something to do
- {用事|ようじ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧: because I have something to do
- {用事|ようじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{済|す}ませる→済ます：02064_sumasu⟧: to finish one's errands
- {用事|ようじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{思|おも}い{出|だ}す→思い出す：01258_omoidasu⟧: to remember something one needs to do

USAGE:
Often used as a polite way to decline invitations or explain why you need to leave. It's vague enough to avoid giving details.

Example: {用事|ようじ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、お⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{失礼|しつれい}します→失礼：01247_shitsurei⟧。
(I have something to attend to, so please excuse me.)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧: work, job (more specific)
- ⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧: plans, schedule
